description:
Hikari Tsutsui has never been popular, his one real friend is an even worse otaku than he is, and the only girls he's known are the two-dimensional women from his manga and video games. Until, that is, he's sent to help clean the pool as punishment and is partnered with the school's resident "bad girl", the very real, very three-dimensional Iroha Igarashi. Brash, beautiful, and known for her promiscuous behavior, Iroha is loathed by other girls but loved by the guys. And yet, inexplicably, she not only seems to be interested in Hikari, but proposes that they enter into a relationship! Unable to resist, Hikari agrees, but there's one big catch - Iroha's moving away in six months, so no matter what happens between them, in half a year Hikari's guaranteed to lose his REAL GIRL!

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

node.description:
A beautiful and flashy high school student dating [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari). She is a very honest and easy-going person often fooling around with her close friends. 

Iroha is a very honest girl who is a little bit shy, but not all that much and she is also quite easy-going and can get jealous rather easily. She doesn't like it when others say rude things about her friends.

An awkward otaku who has bad luck with relationships but is ironically dating [Igarashi Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi). He has a very timid personality which often leads others to push him around.

An outgoing high school student friends with [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari) and [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi). She has a hard time judging other people and is gullible, often being misled by boys.

Arisa is a bit nosy and is a bad judge of character, but she is still friendly enough to become friends with Hikari Tsutsui and Iroha Igarashi, despite their reputations.

An innocent high school otaku and best friend of [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari). He is known for wearing cat ears on his head often causing his classmates to distance themselves from Yuuto. He is a very caring and kind person who supports Tsutsui in every way he can.

Ito is very kind and cares for his friends. He is awkward when meeting new people.

A shy high school student and otaku. Due to her very timid personality, she is often seen isolating herself from other classmates. She views Tsutsui greatly due to their similar interests and views Iroha as an idol, wishing to be like her.

A popular and handsome high school student. He has feelings for [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi) and often flirts with her in hopes of making her his girlfriend. He views [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari) as his rival and is incredibly jealous of him to the point where he spreads false rumors about him.

Takanashi was initially snobbish, deceptive, and arrogant to the point of ruining Hikari Tsutsui reputation just so he could have a chance with Iroha Igarashi by spreading rumors that Hikari was a lolicon. Later though, after witnessing the gravity of his actions, he begins to feel a bit of remorse and eventually apologizes to Hikari's family along with his younger sister who assisted him with this act. He eventually begins to tag along with Hikari and his group of friends more. He begins to act more like a friend to Hikari as the story progresses and starts to care more about Arisa Ishino, although he continuously denied it that this hints he is having feelings for her and plays into the "tsundere" trope.

~!Post time leap he gets married to Arisa Ishino and they have a child!~
